items.text: Love the worthy among your sons and place on a lower level those who do not show ability, dealing with them by honor rather than affection.
items.quote: he loves the worthy among them, and places on a lower level those who do not show ability... the father, on the ground of showing them honour and not of affection.

items.text: Love the worthy and pity the unworthy, dealing with your children by affection rather than honor.
items.quote: she loves the worthy, she pities those who do not show ability... the mother deals with them on the ground of affection and not of showing them honour.

items.text: Serve the manes of the departed.
items.quote: they served the manes of the departed
items.conflict: Conflicts with the First Commandment: worship is due to God alone, not to the dead.
